content: Today, I stumbled on a declaration search problem which loogle could not handle. What's the best way to do the following?

I'd like to search for all definitions in mathlib which have an explicit argument of a given type (in my case, docs#ModelWithCorners). Loogle can tell me all declarations with ModelWithCorners, but does not allow filtering by definitions (neither explicit arguments). The former would be more important.
I think you can do ⊢ (_ : Type _) for definitions.
@Joachim Breitner What do you think about mentioning this in a comment about the possible options? I'm happy to propose a PR.
PR welcome! At some point I'll probably consider adding def and theorem filters, but until then these tricks are good to be known.
Oh, blurb.md is the source of truth. I’ll fix this.
